title: Night signal
description: An acid-yellow playhead scrubs a nocturnal scene one frame at a time.
useCase: Give an editor or creative review tool a direct relationship between a thumbnail timeline and its current visual frame.
interaction: Drag the filmstrip, step frames, or play the sequence
reducedMotion: Autoplay is unavailable; the scrubber and previous/next controls jump directly to the requested frame. The preference updates live.
limitations: The 73-frame SVG composition is deterministic artwork, not a video decoder. Connect a media timeline and generated thumbnails for actual footage.
look: Near-black editor showing a flat teal silhouette night scene with a pale moon above a seven-thumbnail strip, acid-yellow playhead and monospace timecode.
motion: Dragging the strip's range thumb or stepping frames redraws the SVG scene, its moon, structure and figure sliding left at different rates; play advances 73 frames at 24 fps, looping.
adapt: `frame` drives `NightScene`, whose layers offset by `travel`; playback is the 24 fps `tick` loop and scrubbing is the native range over `sf-film-strip`. Swap `NightScene` and the thumbnail frames for real video frames, keeping `step` and the reduced-motion branch.
